incoming.name: History of the Grand Canyon area
incoming.excerpt: In 1935, Hoover Dam started to impound Lake Mead south of the canyon.

incoming.name: Hoover Dam
incoming.excerpt: Lake Mead is the reservoir created behind the dam, named after Elwood Mead, who oversaw the construction of the dam.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Lake Mead is the largest man-made lake and reservoir in the United States.
